visual_name: Toy factory diorama with a belt loop
summary: A dark tilted slab holding five small machines (projector, black unit, monitor, register, order cabinet) around an oval conveyor with orange cards riding it; a pointer shows station tooltips and the camera swoops in for a close-up.
